owner_posts.post_text: Manage and improve varicose veins with homeopathy, before its too late..

🌸 PCOS: How is it Diagnosed? 🌸

Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is one of the most common hormonal conditions in women—but diagnosis isn’t based on just one test.

👉 Doctors use the Rotterdam Criteria for diagnosis.

To confirm PCOS, any 2 out of these 3 must be present:

✔️ Irregular Periods
– Missed periods
– Delayed cycles
– Very light or heavy bleeding

✔️ Signs of High Androgens (Male Hormones)
– Acne
– Excess facial/body hair (hirsutism)
– Hair thinning on scalp

✔️ Polycystic Ovaries on Ultrasound
– Multiple small follicles seen in ovaries
   Listen to your body. Irregular cycles are not “normal” if they persist.

🏥 Consult a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

— Dr. Charu’s Homeopathic Clinic
